attributionNote: Old Testament only. Admitted specifically to close the measured gap: 9,835 verses had exactly one expositor and were therefore blocked by the corroboration rule, concentrated in Numbers, Genesis, 1-2 Chronicles, Deuteronomy, Ezekiel and Leviticus — the Pentateuch and historical books this commentary treats in most detail.
